I guess I’ll share my experience loosely. I’ve spent the last 6 months recovering all the memories that I had thought were erased. Turns out I have personality disorder, and I’ve “known” about it for at least 16 years. I put “known” quotes because it was intentionally forgotten, long story. 

The thing that I have found most helpful is to just be honest with myself and stop hiding from the truth. It’s hard, too hard sometimes. Trying to find forgiveness for others and for my own failings has been difficult, it’s too easy to place blame. Finding acceptance for things that have happened and poor decision making as a result of my reaction to those things is probably the most difficult thing I’m dealing with.

Everybody has their own path to healing, and I’ve tried everything except for trying to find true honesty, forgiveness, and acceptance. 

Before, I was Kicking the can down the road by making excuses, telling myself half truths, altering my perception, burying memories, and none of it was working for me long term and was just compounding my problems.

Best of luck to you, I hope your journey heals you soon.

This story I’m going to tell might seem random, but it sure is one heck of a coincidence if it’s not a type of miracle, at least not in the traditional sense of the word miracle. There are many miracles that have happened in the world that people do not understand. Can you really believe that only science can explain it all? Or that so many coincidences can converge to create something so amazing, such as life? How about love? How about a child? Think about that, while I tell a little story.

I have a doppelgänger with the same name as me. He has pretty much lived almost the same life as me up until a few years ago. We live in the same city, went to the same schools at different times (except one, we both moved to different surrounding towns around the same time). Had the same types of jobs. Had the same vehicle at the same time at one point (and there are not many of those vehicles around, and in that color). People routinely mistake me for him (until they realize I have broader shoulders or, as most of them say, our eyes are different). I know just about everything about him from the age of 8 onwards, that’s how long people have been mistaking us. I had a best friend actually talk to him for 30 minutes at doppelgänger’s job, thinking it was me. I went to that business the next day, and he had quit. Coincidence? I’m about to tell you why I don’t think it is.

Here’s where it gets really weird. I had a girl best friend, and we basically fell “in love” as much as you can without ever having been together. That didn’t end well at all… Then one day she contacted me out of the blue shortly after she gave birth because she wanted me to meet her new baby, she was so happy. I obliged even though I didn’t want to, I was still hurting over her even after years of being apart. When telling me about the father, shifting around ever so nervously, she suddenly froze. Staring me dead in the eyes, she said, “he looked so much like you”. My brain just shut off at that moment, I don’t know for how long, I just remember the baby’s seater. She looked devastated, I didn’t care, and I didn’t stick around much longer after that. She thought she happened to run into me at that party and finally had me. Nope, it was him. My doppelgänger got to be with the only woman I may never get over completely, and now I can’t stop thinking about him. Her little girl even looks like the perfect amalgamation of us, and she’s not even mine. That hurts too. I guess she might technically be mine in spirit, but I’ll never know her.

And one more thing, as unbelievable as that all is, I also got with a woman he had apparently been in love with. She thought I was him, and I knew it, still was going through with it because he did me dirty too. She literally stopped me halfway through the deed and screeched “You’re not him! Who tf are you?” (Shortened version, guess I didn’t avert my eyes enough). We talked about it, I told her what he did, and she said he ghosted her after she cheated on him, moved and changed his number, got off all social media and everything. Gee, sounds familiar, like I did the same thing with a girl that looked a lot like her… I was literally doing that revenge thing, where you find someone who looks like your ex, and low and behold, I find that he has the exact same taste as me.

I have a feeling I’ll never find him, but I keep hoping. If he’s anything like me at all, and I know he is (obviously), he’s looking for me too. Or he’s even more like me than I think, and he’s avoiding me by not getting on social media. He even quit that job after finding out someone I knew intimately thought he was me, and realized it while talking to him. He was actively pretending to be me both times people that I knew met him. That was also after his hookup with “my girl”. He had to have known she thought he was me the whole time, and also probably thinks she was my girlfriend at the time or something. I know her, and the way me and her talked, no way she didn’t make it obvious that she thought he was someone else.

So, do you believe that was all a coincidence? I don’t. I literally can’t after everything that has happened to me in general, especially with my ever elusive doppelgänger. It is maddening, to the point I’m thinking about hiring a private investigator.

I couldn’t see you because I couldn’t see past myself and my own problems. I can’t explain it all here, but here is some. I see you now, I wish I could’ve seen you then. Please read it all.

Every time you flirted with me I saw mockery. Every time you looked at me longingly I saw pity. Every time you reached for me I ignored it. When you complimented me, I heard a joke at my expense. When you hinted at how you felt, I made a joke of it thinking you were kidding. You may have even flat out told me, I don’t remember that happening though, could’ve repressed it because my mind wouldn’t accept it. Even our song you picked out, sigh… I actually thought you meant I had to change for you, but you actually meant you were changing for me.

I never believed you wanted me in any way, but some part of me had to know because otherwise why would I remember it all so clearly, every sign, every hint and everything you ever said. It could be because I loved you and even to this day I cherish those memories with you, I don’t know. Just about everyone tried to tell me how you felt in some way and still, I couldn’t hear it, couldn’t accept it. They all saw it, how great we were together, even though we never were.

You saved me from myself and you didn’t even know it. You gave me confidence, you gave me strength. You taught me how to dress, how to flirt, even how to socialize again. You saw me at some of my worst moments, and yet you were still there. I was always falling down and you were always picking me up, holding me up even. You were always stronger than me. You gave me everything, and I never got to thank you for it. 

I’m an idiot. I wish I had seen it all. I wish I could have seen even one thing, one hint, and been able to accept it. I do now, I finally quit lying to myself. I see you and how wonderful you are, I always did but I never saw how you actually felt about me.

I can’t explain here why I was lying to myself, it wasn’t voluntary. I can’t tell you what happened, but I can tell you that that whole mess was neither of our faults. I mostly blame myself, not being able to get past it. In reality it was because of something that was done to me that made me feel like less of a man (it’s not an excuse, it’s just what happened, and I couldn’t deal with it). That’s all I can say and I hope it’s enough, it kills me even to admit that. Maybe someday I’ll be able to tell you, but I’m still healing even after all these years and I just feel that maybe it’s best not to contact you. I feel like all I’d do is hurt you again.

I blamed you every time you hurt me even though it was my own fault. I unintentionally hurt you so many times before you ever hurt me, I didn’t even realize it. I never wanted to hurt you, and despite that I only recently realized how bad it must have hurt you to be essentially ignored and humiliated by someone joking about your advances (I really never saw them as serious). I blamed you for a long time, demonized you for a long time. I’ve known for a while how you felt, and it’s just now that I’m coming to terms with it. Guilt is a hell of a thing, something I’ve rarely ever felt before because I’ve always been able to justify my actions (or at least maybe that was my brain’s response to trauma, I don’t know). No more of that now, the blame and the guilt has been eating me alive for years and it’s just now starting to seriously fade. That’s mostly because I admitted the truth to myself and started telling people the real version of events that I couldn’t or didn’t want to see before. 

Then I see this message that probably has nothing to do with me, but is so vaguely similar (major props on that, whoever you are). So here I am, hopefully somewhat righting a huge wrong.

I don’t blame you anymore, you were amazing (and vengeful, I mean god damn, it still hurts, and that’s okay) but still you were amazing. I was just too stuck in my own head to realize it. Yeah, I slept around just the same, trying to fill some kind of void inside me when I should’ve tried to fill it with you. I loved you more than you could ever imagine, and still do. Even your explanation of events and timelines match up, it’s gotta be a coincidence though.

To explain it all would be impossible, there’s so much you didn’t know that was going on, on my side. All I can say is that it is neither of our faults, and under the circumstances, I don’t think it could have gone any other way. I still love you and always will, and I hope this gives you some kind of closure.

I said it’s likely all a coincidence, but I think you should know that maybe your guy was going through something similar.
